comics.statusExplain.hiatus1: Hiatus means you are stepping away from working on this {format} for a while, for whatever reason. It tells your readers not to expect new updates in the coming weeks or months.
comics.statusExplain.hiatus2: The hiatus status is automatically lifted when you publish a chapter. You can also change it yourself.
comics.statusExplain.hiatus3: If the {format} stays on hiatus for six months, we automatically mark it as cancelled.
comics.statusExplain.cancelled1: We're sorry you can't continue this {format}. We're glad you're letting your readers know.
comics.statusExplain.cancelled2: Cancelling tells your readers not to expect any new updates.
comics.statusExplain.cancelled3: You can revert this any time by publishing a chapter or changing the status.
comics.statusExplain.finished1: Congratulations on completing your {format}! We hope there are more stories to tell, but for now enjoy the well-earned rest.
comics.statusExplain.finished2: Marking the {format} as complete tells readers it's finished. You can still add special chapters, such as extra epilogues.
comics.statusExplain.finished3: You can cancel this status, but we advise against it. If the {format} is to continue, consider starting a new one.
